messages:
alex: Quick sync — where are we on the console observability rollout? Need clarity on: retention milestone, trace hook ownership, dashboard widget swaps.
maria: I can take dashboards but need the new metric names from infra. There's a naming mismatch: `request.latency_ms` vs `req_lat_ms`.
jordan: That's from the agent change last week. I can add a compatibility layer but it'll take a day. Which dashboards are highest priority?
alex: Thx. Priority: 1) latency heatmap 2) error-insights view 3) SLO panel for /generate route.
maria: Got it. I'll start a PR to convert panels to the new names and leave old ones as fallback.
maria: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/console/pulls/812 — WIP, needs Jordan's mapping and Sam's canary plan.
jordan: I'll drop the mapping in the PR today. Also note: trace hook names changed to `trace.start` -> `trace.span.start` in infra-467.
sam: Canaries: I can run a traffic canary to dedicated for 10% for 24h. Need a quick runbook. alex can you confirm the rollback tag?
alex: Rollback tag is `console-obsv-v1` — use `deployctl rollback console-obsv-v1` if errors spike >5%.
lee: Product: acceptance criteria for error-insights — must show grouped stack traces and top 5 signals by frequency. Also retention tiers: free=7d, standard=30d, pro=90d.
alex: Good. We need to surface retention tiers in the UI. Jordan, implement retention config. Example config:
```
observability:
  traces:
    retention_days: 30
    sample_rate: 0.1
  logs:
    retention_days: 30
```
maria: Small blocker — dashboard widget library v2 removed `histogram_v1` API. My PR adds a shim but it's a risky change.
sam: If shim is risky, can we gate behind feature flag? `FF_OBSV_WIDGETS=v2` and flip only for canary.
jordan: Yep, I'll add the flag in infra config and make it default off.
alex: Action items:
- maria: finish dashboard PR and add FF gate (due EOD today)
- jordan: add name mapping + feature flag (due 24h)
- sam: schedule 10% canary for 24h once PRs merged
- lee: confirm acceptance test list and share sample queries
I'll follow up with a PR checklist and add owners to the console board. :thumbsup:
canary-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-17T16:15Z — 10% traffic to dedicated pool for 24h.
maria: Acknowledged, starting now.
jordan: Mapping added to PR, ping me for review when panels are updated.
sam: I'll queue the canary after PRs merged and confirm rollback readiness.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc with new dates.
